teleconsultation.title: Tele - Consultation With Health Professionals
teleconsultation.description: Connecting rural patients with specialist doctors via high-speed video links, bridging the gap between villages and urban medical centers.

awarenessCamps.title: Awareness And Health Camps
awarenessCamps.description: Regularly conducting village health camps and awareness sessions to educate communities on hygiene, preventive care, and digital consultations.

diagnosticsEMR.title: Diagnosis, EMR Generation And Treatment Plan
diagnosticsEMR.description: Providing on-site diagnostic tests, generating Electronic Medical Records (EMR), and crafting personalized treatment plans for every patient.

referrals.title: Referral Pathways To Esteemed Hospitals
referrals.description: Ensuring seamless guidance and referral pathways to trusted secondary and tertiary partner hospitals for surgeries or advanced treatments.

convenienceSupport.title: Convenience Support
convenienceSupport.description: Assisting patients with logistics, scheduling appointments, travel support, and navigating hospital processes to ensure a hassle-free experience.

financialSupport.title: Financial Support Guidance

impact.title: Health Camps & Awareness.
impact.description: We conduct regular health camps and healthcare awareness drives in remote villages. By educating families about hygiene, preventive care, and digital consultations, we empower rural communities to take control of their health.
impact.campaignDetail1: Interactive sessions educating villages on hygiene, nutrition, and preventive healthcare.
impact.campaignDetail2: Conducting free basic diagnostic checkups and health screenings on-the-ground.
impact.campaignDetail3: Connecting patients directly to remote medical specialists via telemedicine.

bmi.title: BMI Health Assessment
bmi.subtitle: Understand your Body Mass Index and take informed steps toward better health.
bmi.disclaimer: This tool is for general health awareness and does not replace medical advice.

bmiCalculator.readySub: Enter your height and weight to see your health category.

messages.underweight: Your BMI is in the underweight range. Consider consulting a healthcare provider for personalized nutritional advice.
messages.normal: Great job! Your BMI is within the healthy range. Maintain a balanced diet and regular physical activity to stay healthy.
messages.overweight: Your BMI is in the overweight range. Small changes in diet and regular exercise can help you reach a healthier weight.
messages.obese: Your BMI is in the obese range. We recommend consulting a healthcare professional to discuss a personalized health plan.

bmiCalculator.waistHint: Add your waist to also check belly fat. Measure at the level of your navel.
bmiCalculator.waistHigh: Your waist is above the healthy limit for Indian adults (80 cm for women, 90 cm for men). Fat around the belly raises the risk of diabetes and heart disease, even when BMI is normal.
bmiCalculator.waistOk: Your waist is within the healthy limit for Indian adults.
bmiCalculator.adultsOnly: For adults aged 18 and above. Not suitable for children or pregnant women.
bmiCalculator.source: Uses the lower BMI cut-offs recommended for Indians (Indian consensus guidelines, 2009): overweight from 23, obese from 25.

founderTeaser.heading: Built from a personal fight for the right diagnosis
founderTeaser.paragraph1: In 2007, Sandeep Kumar fell ill and spent six months moving between hospitals in his home district before doctors could even diagnose him — his district simply didn't have the specialists or equipment to find the cause. He was eventually diagnosed with Ewing Sarcoma, a bone cancer that nearly cost him his arm and his mobility.
founderTeaser.paragraph2: That experience of being failed by a lack of local healthcare never left him. In July 2020, he invested his own savings to open DigiSwasthya's first telemedicine clinic in that same district — determined to make quality healthcare reachable for rural India.

home.giftsSubtitle: Every amount reaches rural families through our telemedicine centres and health camps.
home.tier500: Brings specialist consultations to rural families.
home.tier1000: Helps run health camps and screenings in villages.
home.tier2500: Supports diagnostics and follow-up care for patients.
home.tier5000: Helps keep a telemedicine centre running for its community.
home.modelLead: Rural communities face shortages of specialist doctors, delayed diagnosis and limited health infrastructure. Our model brings the specialist to the village in four steps.
home.model1Desc: Health camps and our centres check vitals and symptoms on site, so problems are caught early.
home.model2Desc: Trained staff connect the patient with a specialist doctor from a city hospital by video consultation.
home.model3Desc: Patients get a treatment plan, prescriptions from nearby pharmacies, a referral to a partner hospital when needed, and help getting an Ayushman card.
home.model4Desc: Digital health records keep care continuous, and patients facing serious illness such as cancer get guidance and support through treatment.
home.founderQuote: To transform the country's primary healthcare system and make healthcare services affordable and accessible for rural communities by leveraging technology.
home.giftMonthlyNote: A monthly gift helps us plan and keep our centres running.

healthTools.title: Health Tools
healthTools.subtitle: Simple, free tools to check your health risks, and the government health services you can use.
healthTools.disclaimer: These tools are for education and awareness only and do not replace advice from a doctor. Please consult a qualified health professional for advice about your own health.
healthTools.riskTitle: Check your risk of diabetes, high BP and heart disease
healthTools.riskSubtitle: Six questions from the checklist ASHA workers use across India. It takes about a minute.
healthTools.servicesTitle: Government health services you can use today
healthTools.servicesLead: Official Government of India services. Website links open in a new tab.
healthTools.emergency: In a medical emergency, call 108 for an ambulance.
healthTools.guidesLead: Free official guides on nutrition, pregnancy and child growth.

ncdRisk.tobaccoQ: Do you smoke, or use tobacco such as gutkha, khaini or beedi?
ncdRisk.alcoholQ: Do you drink alcohol every day?
ncdRisk.waistHint: Measure with a tape around your belly, at the level of your navel.
ncdRisk.waistPickSex: Choose woman or man above to see the waist sizes.
ncdRisk.activityQ: Are you physically active for at least 150 minutes a week? For example, 30 minutes a day on 5 days.
ncdRisk.activityHint: Walking, cycling, farm work and other physical work all count.
ncdRisk.familyQ: Does your mother, father, brother or sister have high blood pressure, diabetes or heart disease?
ncdRisk.placeholder: Answer all six questions to see your score.
ncdRisk.highTitle: You may be at higher risk
ncdRisk.highBody: A score above 4 means you should get your blood pressure and blood sugar checked. Visit your nearest Ayushman Arogya Mandir (government health centre) or a DigiSwasthya centre.
ncdRisk.lowBody: Keep up healthy habits: stay active, avoid tobacco and alcohol, and eat less salt, sugar and oil. Have your blood pressure and sugar checked from time to time.
ncdRisk.warningTitle: Whatever your score, see a doctor soon if you have:
ncdRisk.warning1: A cough for more than 2 weeks, or blood when you cough or spit
ncdRisk.warning2: A mouth ulcer, or a white or red patch in the mouth, that has not healed in 2 weeks
ncdRisk.warning4: Bleeding after menopause, between periods or after sex
ncdRisk.source: Based on the Community Based Assessment Checklist (CBAC) of the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India.
